remarks:
Welcome to 354 Bryant St, a striking Victorian residence situated on a prominent corner lot just steps from the heart of Elmwood Village. Offering 2,332 SQFT, this historic 3 bed 1.5 bath brick home combines timeless architectural character with modern comfort, featuring impressive 10-foot ceilings, a French door entryway, dual staircase, pocket doors, recessed lighting, and exceptional natural presence throughout. 

The main level offers a spacious living room with a fireplace, an open dining room ideal for entertaining, and a versatile bonus room perfect for a home office, sitting room, or additional living space. At the center of the home is a timeless kitchen appointed with beautiful wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a large island, and an inviting eat-in breakfast nook. Upstairs, you’ll find three spacious bedrooms and an impressive full bathroom featuring a soaking tub, separate stand-up shower, double vanity, and convenient second-floor laundry. 

Outside, a private paver brick courtyard offers a secluded setting for entertaining and relaxation, while off-street parking and a detached two-car garage provide a rare level of convenience in the city. Notable improvements include a newer furnace and central air, younger tear-off roof, updated vinyl windows, 150-amp electrical service, 2021 hot water tank, and new refrigerator, dishwasher, washer and dryer all in 2025. 

All of this is within walking distance of the shops, restaurants, cafés, and energy that define Elmwood Village. With its commanding architecture, generous scale, private outdoor space, and exceptional location, 354 Bryant St is a distinctive opportunity in one of Buffalo’s most sought-after neighborhoods. 

Showings begin immediately. Open house this Saturday 10/17 from 11-1 PM!
